div.div: سِينٌ One of the letters of the alphabet: (S, M, L, K:) [i. e., the name of that letter: (see art. س:)] of the masc. gender as being supposed to be a حَرْف [or letter], and fem. as being supposed to be a كَلِمَة [or word]. (L.) The saying فُلَانٌ لَا يَحْسِنُ سِنَهُ means Such a one will not form well one of the three شُعَب [i. e. teeth, or cusps,] of his س. (S, L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
